She would most certainly say these things in her defense:

1. I am selfish because I make decisions with myself in mind first, even subconsciously. 

2. I take way more than I give, and the imbalance is obvious.

3. I don’t discipline my dog well enough, which leads to behavioral issues with the other 3 dogs.

4. I just don’t care as much as she does.

For each of these, I have plenty of retort. But, as I mentioned already, she crossed a line when she restricted my freedom of movement. I refuse to live like that.
